source='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    """Fill each rectangular hollow outline by its interior-area parity."""
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            queue = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            component = []
            while queue:
                y, x = queue.popleft()
                component.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y - 1, x), (y + 1, x), (y, x - 1), (y, x + 1)):
                    if (0 <= ny < height and 0 <= nx < width
                            and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        queue.append((ny, nx))

            top = min(y for y, _ in component)
            bottom = max(y for y, _ in component)
            left = min(x for _, x in component)
            right = max(x for _, x in component)
            if bottom - top < 2 or right - left < 2:
                continue

            border = ((y, x) for y in range(top, bottom + 1)
                      for x in range(left, right + 1)
                      if y in (top, bottom) or x in (left, right))
            if not all(grid[y][x] == color for y, x in border):
                continue

            interior = [(y, x) for y in range(top + 1, bottom)
                        for x in range(left + 1, right) if grid[y][x] == background]
            fill_color = 2 if len(interior) % 2 == 0 else 7
            for y, x in interior:
                out[y][x] = fill_color

    return out
'''
